name: Backbone
kid: Super-fast connections between big network boxes.
nerd: 100–400G links between routers, often carrying MPLS.

1995.nerd: Drawn as today (100–400G, MPLS). In 1995 backbone links were 45 Mbit/s T3s and 155 Mbit/s OC-3s, often carrying ATM.

2010.nerd: 10–40G links between routers, often carrying MPLS; the first 100G links came in 2010.
